info.title: FineX API
info.summary: Trace stolen USDT from a reported wallet to the exchange account that received it.
info.description: Every route answers with JSON. Chain-reading routes are rate-limited per client (HTTP 429 with Retry-After) so one integrator cannot spend the shared chain budget. Nothing here needs a key. A wallet the chain did not answer for is reported as unread, never as empty. Attribution is a deterministic lookup; no language model is involved. Integration with NCRP or SAHYOG is designed around these routes but is not live.

post.description: Traces USDT forward from the wallet (TRON, Ethereum, or Polygon when chain is 'polygon'), up to three hops, and returns the full TraceResult: wallets, transfers, the exit and the deposit account named, risk flags, triage (HOT / WARM / COLD) and the SHA-256 of every chain response. Send Accept: application/x-ndjson to receive progress events, one JSON line each, then the result.

amount.description: Reported loss in USDT. Omit to follow everything that left the wallet.

fraudDate.description: Omit to start from the wallet's first transfer.

chain.description: Only for a 0x address on Polygon; otherwise the address decides.

asOf.description: Read the chain as it stood at this moment, to replay a recorded run.

get.summary: Trace a wallet by link (the permalink)
get.description: The same trace as POST, with the run pinned in the query string, so a shared link reproduces the same figures on any later day. The header x-finex-provenance says live or recorded.

get.summary: Resolve a transaction to the wallet it paid
get.description: For a complaint that has a transaction rather than a wallet: reads the transaction's USDT transfer (TRON or Ethereum) and returns the wallet it paid. A transaction that moved no USDT says so.

200.description: The transfer and the wallet it paid.

get.description: Age, USDT in and out, and its counterparties on both sides, each run through the attribution table. A partial history is marked partial.

get.summary: Trace backwards: who paid this wallet
get.description: The wallet's payers and the exchanges that funded them, one hop back (TRON and Ethereum).

get.summary: Screen any address against the OFAC SDN list
get.description: Recognises the address's chain (20 assets) and checks it against the published OFAC list. Reads no chain. Listed is a finding; not listed is not a clearance.
Reads the USDT contract's own blacklist on TRON, Ethereum or Polygon.

get.summary: A TRON address's public explorer tag, read live
get.description: The explorer's own words, for wallets where a trace stopped at its search limit. An annotation, never an attribution. 502 when the explorer did not answer, which is not the same as no tag.

get.summary: The case register, as this server has read it
get.description: Saved cases, the traces this server answered, and the recorded reference wallets re-read live every six hours. Each row says where it came from and when it was read. Reads the server's own files only.

post.summary: Save a run to the case file
post.description: Built from the server's own audit record of the trace, found by its findings fingerprint; a run the server did not trace cannot be saved.

404.description: No such run on this server.

delete.summary: Remove a case from the case file

post.description: For each wallet sent: moved, still at rest, or not checked. An unanswered wallet is never reported as at rest.

post.summary: Turn browser alerts on for a watch list

get.description: Every trace, save, removal and alert switch, each entry carrying the SHA-256 of the one before. format=jsonl downloads the whole log for scripts/verify-audit.mjs.

get.summary: How this deployment is set up
get.description: Commit served, demo mode, and where each kind of chain read goes. Reads no chain.
Each chain's newest block, read now, the OFAC list's date, the USDT/INR rate and today's trace count. Kept 30 seconds.
The last traded USDT/INR on CoinDCX, with WazirX as the fallback, with its source and read time. { rate: null } when neither answered.
